Callout.Name: Firearms Interdiction
Callout.Message: Vehicle believed to be carrying firearms into the city.
Callout.Advisory: Two occupants, vehicle known to the agency.

Script.Line: There is nothing in the car. Search it, go on.
I am insured. Everything on this car is legal.
You are not opening the boot. You are not opening it.

Lines.Briefing: If it runs it runs, but the weapons go with it. Take the lay-by stop.
Lines.Approach: It came off the highway twenty minutes ago. Do not stop it in traffic - wait for the lay-by.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
